people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
translations.bsb: Each one threw down his staff, and it became a serpent. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up the other staffs.
translations.kjv: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
translations.asv: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
